caseName: Pedersen v. J. F. Fitzgerald Construction Co.
caseNameFull: Pedersen v. J. F. Fitzgerald Construction Co.
attorneys: Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this case. Mr. Daniel H. Prior for petitioner. Messrs. Henry E. Foley and Charles E. Nichols for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment reversed on the authority of Overstreet v. North Shore Corporation, ante, p. 125.
